days.title: North and Central Sights
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Aktivitätenzentrum De Zevenboom
stops.detail: In the north, near the village of Afferden, lies the 'De Zevenboom Activity Center'.

stops.name: Besucherzentrum De Maasduinen
stops.detail: In the central part lies the most recently built 'De Maasduinen Visitor Center' between the towns of Well and Nieuw Bergen.

stops.name: Nierskanal
stops.detail: The most important flowing waters are the Maas and, by a very clear margin, the Niers canal.

days.title: Southern History and Nature
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Empfangsstelle Jachthut op den Hamer
stops.detail: At the southern edge, approximately halfway between Wellerlooi and Arcen, the 'Jachthut op den Hamer Reception Center' is located.

stops.name: Vorstengraf
stops.detail: Evidence of settlement as far back as pre-Christian times is provided by finds such as arrow and spearheads and axes, as well as burial fields and burial mounds, of which the Vorstengraf (Prince's Grave) is the most significant.
